plain_math_description: The local carrier chart has a vertical fiber direction and a base direction. The raw base coordinate is not globally independent from the fiber because it carries a connection component. The horizontal base lift subtracts that component, making its tangent metric-orthogonal to the fiber direction in the local S3 carrier chart.
